name: NFTG
rootCause: NFTG was exploited on BNB Chain on 26 November 2024 due to improper access control in its presale contract, allowing an attacker to extract approximately $10,000 in USDT through repeated unauthorized presale calls enabled by a helper contract. The vulnerable NFTG presale contract lacked proper access control on a presale function callable with arbitrary parameters, allowing unauthorized contracts to repeatedly invoke privileged mint or withdrawal operations and drain funds.
